description: Embed 2 or more texts with an AWS Bedrock embedding model (Amazon Titan, Cohere) and return a cosine-similarity matrix. Scores range 0 (unrelated) to 1 (identical meaning). Useful for semantic search, deduplication, and clustering.

model.description: Embedding model alias: 'titan-v2' (default), 'titan-multimodal', 'cohere' (Embed v4), or a full model ID

texts.description: List of 2-50 texts to embed and compare pairwise

name: bedrock_embed_similarity
